title: About Us - Adatvezérelt Marketing Szövetség | DIMSZ | Data & Marketing Association Hungary

facts.fact: DIMSZ is a member of FEDMA and of GDMA (Global Data Marketing & Analytics).
facts.quote: A szervezet a [FEDMA](https://fedma.org/) és a GDMA (Global [Data Marketing & Analytics](https://thedma.org/)) tagja.

facts.fact: DIMSZ joined a joint statement on the advertising tax (reklámadó), initiated by the Hungarian Advertising Association (MRSZ), together with twelve other professional organizations.
facts.quote: tizenkét társszakmai szervezettel együtt csatlakozott ahhoz a közleményhez

facts.fact: DIMSZ has established a Code of Conduct emphasizing self-regulation, sustainability, and ethical practices, and states that all its member companies operate under these shared principles.
facts.quote: DIMSZ has established a Code of Conduct that emphasizes self-regulation, sustainability, and ethical practices.

facts.fact: DIMSZ states that it brings together service providers, agencies, and advertisers.
facts.quote: DIMSZ brings together service providers, agencies, and advertisers to strengthen the reputation of data-driven marketing.
